title: EEG recordings for 200 object images presented in RSVP sequences at 5Hz or 20Hz
description: EEG recordings from participants viewing 200 object images presented in rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) streams at 5 Hz or 20 Hz. The dataset supports investigation of the temporal representational dynamics of visual object processing under rapid presentation conditions. It accompanies a published NeuroImage study on object representations in RSVP streams.
methods_description: EEG recordings were collected while participants viewed object images presented in RSVP sequences at two different presentation rates (5 Hz and 20 Hz). The dataset includes recordings for 200 distinct object images.
